description: Get the status and output of a Skyvern run by run_id, optionally waiting up to wait_seconds for it to finish. Final statuses are completed, failed, terminated, timed_out and canceled; anything else means keep polling. Requires your own Skyvern API key as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your Skyvern API key (from your Skyvern account settings). Every run is billed to your Skyvern account.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for a final status (0 to 20, default 0).

name: skyvern_get_run
title: Skyvern Get Run
